card.name: Pest behavior in insect descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words and verbs right after a pest or parasite subject in descriptions of insects, spiders or worms, such as "feed on", "will invade" and "variety of".

modes.label: Feeding phrases
modes.description: Words in "feed on" or "a wide variety of" describing what a pest eats.
modes.example: These insects feed<< on>> starchy materials and even non-food materials

modes.label: Pest action verbs
modes.description: A verb after "will" saying what a pest does in the home or to people.
modes.example: They will<< bite>> humans even when unprovoked.

modes.label: Habitat and host phrases
modes.description: Prepositions or adjectives placing a pest in a location or on a host.
modes.example: Hymenolepis nana is the most common tapeworm<< in>> humans, particularly in Asia.

card.plain: It fires on little words in pest-control style text about what insects and parasites eat, bite or infest.

They will<< bite>> humans even when unprovoked.
They feed on a wide variety<< of>> plant and animal material.
